The slider uses equal whole-MiB steps inside the free region. Tick marks are MiB alignment marks, thinned on large regions, not the partition-map block edges; the LBA and size fields stay authoritative.

The slider is a uniform whole-MiB scale of the selected free region, not a proportional disk map. Tick marks are MiB alignment marks; on large regions they are thinned, so only the two labelled ends are exact: the first usable aligned LBA and the last sector the right handle can select. These are the selectable span limits, not necessarily the neighbouring block edges: an unaligned region start skips a few sectors and an unaligned tail stays outside the MiB span. The left handle sets the start. The right handle sets the end. The start must stay aligned to 1 MiB. The whole range must fit inside the region. The reducer checks the values again before a write. Type the LBA and sector count directly to use an end that is not MiB-aligned. Snap to existing partition edges lives on the raw-write disk map, where those blocks are drawn.

Writes only the sector ranges in the map onto %1$s; the disk outside them is not changed. COPIED ranges are compared with the image and mismatches are rewritten. COPY is refused while any range is NON_TRIED. FAILED ranges are restored from image bytes (a backup usually writes zeros there). Sector size must match and the map must fit the disk; full disk geometry need not match.

Relocates and checksums the backup GPT at the current disk end. Does not load a file.

Fix backup GPT moves the on-disk backup header and entry array to the current end of this medium and recalculates checksums. It needs a readable primary GPT. It does not read a saved file. Restore GPT from file is a separate Diagnostics action that writes a previously captured primary+backup blob.

Update rewrites the boot files and keeps all files on the data partition. Clean install erases every partition and file, writes a fresh layout and formats the data partition; it asks for confirmation first. The version shown is bundled with this app; the version already on the stick is not read.

Update rewrites boot files and keeps all files on the data partition.
Erases all partitions and files on the drive, writes a fresh Ventoy layout and formats the data partition. Confirmation is required before writing.

Resume needs a matching USB serial, disk identity and geometry. Each copied range is re-read from the disk and compared with the current image data; mismatches are rewritten. Do not change the image until the operation finishes: the image is read as-is, a change can leave mixed data, and no snapshot or immutability is promised. Partial COPY is refused; FAILED sectors are written as zeros.

Restore GPT from file writes a saved primary+backup critical-sector blob onto this medium after validation. It is not the same as Fix backup GPT on the Partitions tab, which only relocates the live backup structures to the current disk end. A file name alone does not prove the blob matches this disk.
